title: Effect of temporomandibular joint exercises on mechanical low back pain: a preliminary randomized controlled study
comparison_or_design: The randomized temporomandibular-exercise study in mechanical low back pain.
observations_or_assays: Oswestry disability score (ODQ/ODI as labeled in the source)
time_scope: Baseline to the end of 2 weeks.
excluded: Any numerical/group-label correction inferred from inconsistencies
population_or_material: Participants with mechanical low back pain in the two randomized physiotherapy groups, using the reported pain-analysis population.
requested_items: Literal Table 2 Group A/B baseline/post means, published changes and tests for resting pain, activity pain and disability. Use Methods treatment mapping; preserve contradictory narrative labels and unusual source values in separate review records without swapping groups or recalculating changes.
case_specific_rules: Recover Group A/B treatment identities from the Methods, giving that source precedence over contradictory narrative labels. Preserve Table 2 values and their stated group labels; apply the shared rules for unreported calculation direction and unusual reported values.
